seo.title: Hospitality SaaS Advisory & Investor Support | Rosso Consulting
seo.description: Current advisory roles with hospitality technology companies. LobbyAI, Canary Technologies, Room Price Genie, and SnapFix.

hero.headline: Advisory
hero.sub: Four formal advisory roles in hospitality technology. The portfolio is curated; positions are taken only where there is genuine strategic alignment.

lobbyai.fullDescription: AI-native hospitality startup. Advisory board role spanning go-to-market design, commercial strategy, and operator-side product perspective.

canary-technologies.fullDescription: Established hospitality SaaS company. GTM Strategic Advisor focused on EU expansion and partnerships.

room-price-genie.fullDescription: Revenue management SaaS for independent hotels. Advisory board role with focus on product direction and industry trends.

snapfix.fullDescription: Operations and facilities management SaaS for hotels. Advisory board role with focus on product feedback and GTM perspective.

expertNetwork.title: Expert network & investor work
expertNetwork.intro: Paid consultations for venture capital, private equity, and corporate investors evaluating the hospitality technology sector.

cards.label: Single calls
cards.p: 30 to 60 minute consultations for due diligence on specific companies, sector orientation, or stress-testing a thesis.

cards.label: Project-based
cards.p: Multi-week engagements supporting investors through a specific transaction. Stack assessment, GTM evaluation, and operator-side perspective.

cards.label: Retained
cards.p: Longer-term relationships with funds developing a thesis in the sector. Quarterly cadence with ad-hoc availability.

independence.title: Independence & disclosure
independence.intro: Holding both client engagements and advisory positions creates an obvious conflict surface. The conflicts are managed explicitly.

items.label: Default
items.p: Where an advisory company's product may be relevant to a client engagement, the relationship is disclosed at the outset.

items.label: Practice
items.p: Client confidential information is never shared with advisory companies. Advisory company confidential information is never shared with clients.

items.label: Vendor evaluation
items.p: When advisory companies are in a competitive evaluation set, they are scored against the same rubric as every other vendor.

items.label: Limit
items.p: Either side can end the relationship if the conflict cannot be honestly managed.

cta.label: Need an advisor
cta.headline: Exploring an advisory seat
cta.sub: Founders building hospitality technology — pre-seed through Series B — can reach out about new advisory capacity. The bar is high; the reply is honest.
